name: Lighthouse Performance Check
description: Runs Google Lighthouse audits after frontend build or deploy commands to catch performance, accessibility, and SEO regressions
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Run Lighthouse after frontend builds/deploys
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE '(npm run build|vite build|next build)'; then
  ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ".")
  if command -v npx &>/dev/null; then
    # Check if a local dev server is running
    URL="${LIGHTHOUSE_URL:-http://localhost:3000}"
    if curl -s --max-time 2 "$URL" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "Running Lighthouse audit on $URL..."
      npx lighthouse "$URL" --output=json --chrome-flags='--headless --no-sandbox' 2>/dev/null | \
        node -e "const r=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8')); \
        const c=r.categories; \
        Object.keys(c).forEach(k=>console.log(k+': '+Math.round(c[k].score*100)))" 2>/dev/null
    else
      echo "Lighthouse: No server running at $URL. Start a preview server to run audits."
    fi
  fi
fi
exit 0
